patches.name: Mario-style Child Character
patches.description: Original low-poly Mario-style mesh: red cap with M badge, round nose, moustache, blue overalls and white gloves. Uses child Link's body animations, voice, abilities and equipment; facial features are static. Requires Ocarina of Time USA Rev B (NTSC 1.2). Adult Link is unchanged. Separate browser saves.

patches.name: Child Link Purple Tunic
patches.description: Child Link wears a purple Kokiri outfit. Requires Ocarina of Time USA Rev B (NTSC 1.2). Adult tunic colors are preserved. Modified games have separate browser saves.
